segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: On the night before everything changed, Jesus sat with his disciples and told them not to let their hearts be troubled.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He was going somewhere — but not to leave them behind. He was going to get a place ready.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A house with room for everyone. He said it plainly — if it were not true, he would have told them.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He was not describing a far-off maybe.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He was promising to come back and carry them home himself.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He went to prepare a place — and he's coming back for you. You are not forgotten.
